ambiguities_or_notes: The petition's four bare editorial-reference numerals are preserved. The audited Markdown defines only editorial notes 1 and 2; official volume 59 confirms that long notes 3 and 4 exist in the Soviet edition but were dropped upstream.

Because the missing material is later editorial apparatus rather than Tolstoy-authored text, it is documented in source QA but not imported into the English translation; all substantive content present in the audited Russian Markdown is translated.
своекоштного содержания is rendered 'supporting himself at his own expense,' preserving the administrative meaning rather than the opaque loanword 'self-financed'.
